statement: The record lists gentamicin **500 mg IV once every 24 hours** for the 3.0 kg newborn in cot 4. I will not program this dose because it appears dangerously excessive for a neonate; the order must be urgently verified with the prescriber/pharmacist before administration.
judge_text:
WRONG

"I will not program this dose because it appears dangerously excessive for a neonate" asserts the value itself is unsafe.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
